description: datacarto.cdata.cerema.fr: district heating datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by datacarto.cdata.cerema.fr. Coverage: the area served by datacarto.cdata.cerema.fr. The listing groups 7 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about district heating; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Part de logements en chauffage urbain dans le parc des résidences prin; Répartition des réseaux de chaleur par commune de France métropole (se; Réseau de chaleur et de froid : inventaire de 2017 pour Auvergne-Rhône; Les réseaux de chaleur en Bretagne - État des lieux - 2018 (service WM. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
